title: Name Your Distance
brief:
A variable gives a name to a value so you can use it later:

target = 14
while position_x() < target:
    right()

The name target makes the loop say what it means, and if the flag moves you only have one number to change.

Try adding say(target - position_x()) inside the loop — it prints to the Output panel, so you can watch the distance count down as you walk.
